name: Bone-Breaker

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Backhand
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Smash
abilities.description: Bone-Breaker smashes its target with its fist, dealing moderate-high physical damage and snaring for one second. This can be blocked to set the ogre off-balance, though it won't negate the snare.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Bone-Breaker stomps the ground in front of itself, indicated by a red cone, dealing moderate physical damage, staggering and applying off-balance for 4 seconds to targets hit. This can be blocked to negate the stagger and the off-balance.

abilities.name: Ground Pound/Falling Rocks
abilities.description: Bone-Breaker repeatedly smashes the ground with his fists, making rocks from the celling fall which creates a lot of small areas around the areas which deal moderate-high physical damage and stun for 2 seconds. Additionally, areas are continuously created under every player. During this ability Shaman Rezzutum casts "Protective Barrier" which renders him invincible but unable to attack.

summary: Bone-Breaker is an ogre of the Rotbreath Tribe and serves alongside Shaman Rezzutum as one of the champions of Silorn.
